label: copy-phase re-input of digit 0 (from 4th output on)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at the step where the fed-back input token is the digit 0 (99% of activation mass has in_tok == 0), and only from recall_idx 3 onward (strongest at t = 12-13, recall_idx 4-5, and in longer L). Never fires in the original phase, on <DEL>, on other digits, or at the first three copy outputs. It is a sparse subset of these steps: only about 24% of copy-phase 0 inputs activate. Magnitude depends on the token about to be output (the original token after the 0). It is highest when that token is 3, f, p, z, h, r or 2, and also on sequences with more digits. Restricting to those output tokens raises precision to about 0.45-0.57 but loses recall, and the set has no clean structure. A small residual fires weakly on h/f/3 inputs at similar positions.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 0, h, 2, 3, f, b; least: 1, m, s, j) and the token being output (most: 3, f, p, h, z, 2; least: a, -, w, v); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=5, t=12.
